raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
`match_cutedsl_decode` (#42251) reproduces FlashInfer's CuTe DSL decode kernel, including PTX `ex2.approx` / `lg2.approx` emitted through `inline_asm_elementwise` with `"=f,f"` constraints. AMDGCN rejects that asm (`error: could not allocate output register for constraint 'f'`), but the launch still runs and returns wrong values. So on ROCm both `TestKDAVerifyDecodeParity` tests that set `match_decode=True` fail. CI shows only the first because the suite stops early:

```
FAIL: test_bf16_state_verify_matches_single_token_launches (head_dim=128)
AssertionError: False is not true
```

https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38317177892/job/115041491883

No production caller sets `match_cutedsl_decode`; the parity test is its only user. So the wrapper now raises `NotImplementedError` on ROCm instead of returning wrong values. The two parity tests skip on ROCm, and a ROCm-only test checks that the error is raised. The default-path test in the same class keeps running on ROCm.

Everything here is gated on `_is_hip`, so NVIDIA behaviour is unchanged.

The other KDA failure on ROCm (`test_glm_fp32_weights_bit_exact_on_rocm`) has an unrelated cause and is fixed separately in #43991.

## Test plan

Locally on MI355X (gfx950), `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.21-rocm10-mi35x-20261007`:

- [x] `TestKDAVerifyDecodeParity`: 2 failures + 1 error → OK (2 skipped; the default-path test and the new ROCm guard test pass)
- [x] Full `test_kda_kernels.py`: 20 run, OK (2 skipped). The `constraint 'f'` errors go from 22 to 0

CI, `test_kda_kernels.py`:

- [x] MI300 (gfx942), `stage-b-test-1-gpu-large-amd` part 2: passed on the [current head](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38519830491/job/116268071498) and [before the main merge](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38422141166/job/115392034837). `test_default_path_keeps_fp32_state_across_the_chain` and `test_parity_mode_is_rejected_on_rocm` ran, the two parity tests skipped, and there are no `constraint 'f'` errors
- [x] NVIDIA, base-b: [passed before the main merge](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38422140921/job/115390318091), with all three `TestKDAVerifyDecodeParity` tests still running there. It didn't run on the current head, because base-b stops earlier on the unrelated failure below

## Remaining red checks

- `stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x` part 0 fails `test_fused_kda_conv_recurrent_verify.py` ([log](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38519830491/job/116268072880)). That is the other half of the KDA ROCm fix, in #43991.
- CUDA base-b stops at `vlm/test_unlimited_ocr_server.py`, which can't load `baidu/Unlimited-OCR` without `trust_remote_code` ([log](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38519830840/job/115718859427)). The other base-b partitions fast-fail behind it, and it fails the same way on #43991.

detail.title: [Fix] [AMD] kda: Reject match_cutedsl_decode on ROCm and skip its parity tests

files.patch:
@@ -581,6 +581,14 @@ def fused_sigmoid_gating_delta_rule_update(
             "match_cutedsl_decode is defined for the KDA softplus gate only "
             "(is_kda=True, lower_bound=None)."
         )
+    if match_cutedsl_decode and _is_hip:
+        # The parity branch emits PTX (ex2/lg2.approx) to reproduce FlashInfer's
+        # CuTe DSL decode kernel. AMDGCN rejects it at compile time but the launch
+        # still runs, so without this check ROCm silently returns wrong values.
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            "match_cutedsl_decode reproduces an NVIDIA-only kernel and is not "
+            "available on ROCm."
+        )
     B, T, H, K, V = *k.shape, v.shape[-1]
     stride_q = q.stride()[1]
     stride_k = k.stride()[1]

@@ -790,6 +790,7 @@ def _run_decode_loop_and_verify(B, T, H, K, state_dtype, match_decode):
         )
         return decode_output, decode_state, verify_output, verify_state[slots]
 
+    @unittest.skipIf(torch.version.hip, "match_cutedsl_decode is NVIDIA-only")
     def test_bf16_state_verify_matches_single_token_launches(self):
         for K in (128, 64):
             with self.subTest(head_dim=K):
@@ -818,6 +819,7 @@ def test_default_path_keeps_fp32_state_across_the_chain(self):
             verify_output.float(), decode_output.float(), atol=2e-2, rtol=1e-2
         )
 
+    @unittest.skipIf(torch.version.hip, "match_cutedsl_decode is NVIDIA-only")
     def test_fp32_state_pool_is_not_rounded(self):
         _, decode_state, _, verify_state = self._run_decode_loop_and_verify(
             B=2, T=16, H=4, K=128, state_dtype=torch.float32, match_decode=True
@@ -826,6 +828,13 @@ def test_fp32_state_pool_is_not_rounded(self):
         rounded = verify_state.to(torch.bfloat16).to(torch.float32)
         self.assertFalse(torch.equal(verify_state, rounded))
 
+    @unittest.skipUnless(torch.version.hip, "ROCm rejects the parity mode")
+    def test_parity_mode_is_rejected_on_rocm(self):
+        with self.assertRaises(NotImplementedError):
+            self._run_decode_loop_and_verify(
+                B=1, T=1, H=1, K=64, state_dtype=torch.bfloat16, match_decode=True
+            )
+
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
